name: node-test-verifier
description: Cursor pack with a reusable Node and Jest test-verifier subagent plus project guidance for low-noise, pass-fail-first verification with explicit evidence and optional coverage.
author: felipeblassioli

lite.description: Installs the reusable test-verifier subagent and documentation without persistent project rules.

strict.description: Installs the same subagent plus project-only guidance for tier selection, prerequisite checks, pass-fail-first summaries, and repo-local verifier contracts.

notes: Strict installs add persistent project guidance for using the verifier after substantive changes.
User installs skip rules because Cursor user rules are managed in settings rather than a ~/.cursor/rules directory.
